title: Andrea Mihajlov - Videos
description:
Helping millennials create their best relationship EVER.
Because healthy love isn't luck, it's a skill.

I'm Andrea, a couples therapist and emotional literacy coach with over 9 years of experience working with individuals and couples. 

Here you'll find real-life examples & practical tools to help you communicate better and break the cycles you inherited.
+ sharing lessons from what made my 12-year marriage thrive

📌 New here? Start with the video of your liking.
💬 Ready for 1-on-1 work (ENG/SRB)? Book your discovery call on the link below.
